The '''Falador Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas in and near [[Falador]], such as [[Burthorpe]], [[Rimmington]], and [[Taverley]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements. For the [[#Elite|elite tier]] of this diary, the player must have completed all [[quest]]s, or achieved [[level 99]] in any skill.

Rewards can be claimed from [[Sir Rebral]] in the [[White Knights' Castle]]'s courtyard in [[Falador]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.

==Easy==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Falador" data-diary-tier="Easy"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Find out what your family crest is from [[Sir Renitee]]
''Note: You must finish the dialogue.''
|
*{{SCP|Construction|16|link=yes}}
|-
|2. Climb over the western [[Falador]] wall.
|
*{{SCP|Agility|5|link=yes}}
|-
|3. Browse [[Sarah's Farming shop.|Sarah's farm shop]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|4. Get a Haircut or a Shave from the [[Hairdresser|Falador Hairdresser]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|5. Fill a [[bucket]] from the [[Waterpump (Falador)|pump]] north of [[Falador west bank]].
|
*[[Bucket]]
|-
|6. Kill a [[duck]] in [[Falador Park]].
|
*None, though using [[Magic]] or a [[Ranged#Weapons|Ranged weapon]] is recommended
|-
|7. Make a [[mind tiara]].
|
*[[Tiara]] and a [[mind talisman]]
|-
|8. Take the [[Monk_of_Entrana|boat]] to [[Entrana]].
|
*Have no [[weapons]] or [[armour]] equipped or in your inventory
|-
|9. Repair a [[broken strut]] in the [[Motherlode Mine]].
|
*[[Hammer]] and any [[pickaxe]]
|-
|10. Claim a [[security book]] from the [[Security guard]] at [[Port Sarim]] jail.
''Note: The guard is found upstairs. Ask him about security and finish the dialogue.''
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|11. Smith some [[Blurite Limbs]] on [[Doric]]'s anvil.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[The Knight's Sword]] and [[Doric's Quest]]
*{{SCP|Mining|10|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Smithing|13|link=yes}}
*[[Hammer]] and a [[Blurite bar]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Falador shield 1]]:
**Can restore 25% of [[prayer points]] once a day
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill of at least level 30
*Access to the [[Tight-gap (Goblin Village)|tight-gap shortcut]] from [[Burthorpe]] to the [[Chaos Temple (Asgarnia)|Chaos Temple]] (with 14 [[Agility]])

==Medium==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Falador" data-diary-tier="Medium"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Light a [[Bullseye lantern]] at the [[Chemist|Chemist's]] in [[Rimmington]].
|
*{{SCP|Firemaking|49|link=yes}}
*[[Tinderbox]] and a regular [[bullseye lantern]]
|-
|2. [[Telegrab]] some [[Wine of Zamorak]] at the [[Chaos Temple (Asgarnia)|Chaos Temple]] by the [[Wilderness]].
''Note: This altar is located north-west of the [[Goblin Village]]. You have to be inside the building until the jug appears in your inventory for the task to register as completed.''
|
*{{SCP|Magic|33|link=yes}}
*Means to cast [[Telegrab]] ({{RuneReq|Air=1|Law=1}})
|-
|3. Unlock the [[Crystal chest]] in [[Taverley]].
|
*[[Crystal key]]
|-
|4. Place a [[Scarecrow]] in the [[Falador farm]] flower patch.
|
*{{SCP|Farming|23|link=yes}} ([[Ironman mode|Ironman accounts]] require {{SCP|Farming|47|link=yes}} or the ability to kill [[gryphon]]s)
*[[Bronze spear]], [[watermelon]], and a [[hay sack]] (you can fill an [[empty sack]] with hay at the [[hay bale]] in the chicken coop nearby.)
|-
|5. Kill a [[Mogre]] at [[Mudskipper Point]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Skippy and the Mogres]]
*{{SCP|Slayer|32|link=yes}}
*[[Fishing explosive]]. 
* It is not possible to skip having to complete Skippy and the Mogres, or needing a fishing explosive, by killing them through a boat cannon through the Sailing skill.
|-
|6. Visit the [[Port Sarim]] [[Rat Pits]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Ratcatchers]]
|-
|7. Grapple up and then jump off the north [[Falador]] wall.
|
*{{SCP|Agility|11|link=yes}}, {{SCP|Strength|37|link=yes}}, and {{SCP|Ranged|19|link=yes}}
*[[Mith grapple]]{{efn|[[Ironman Mode|Ironmen]] require either access to the [[Ancient Cavern]] or 59 [[Smithing]] and 59 [[Fletching]] for a [[mith grapple]].}} and any [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]]
|-
|8. Pickpocket a [[Falador]] [[guard]].
|
*{{SCP|Thieving|40|link=yes}}
|-
|9. Pray at the [[Stone circle|Altar of Guthix]] in [[Taverley]] whilst wearing full [[Initiate armour|Initiate]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Recruitment Drive]]
*{{SCP|Prayer|10|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Defence|20|link=yes}}
*[[Initiate armour]]
|-
|10. Mine some [[Gold ore]] at the [[Crafting Guild]].
|
*{{SCP|Crafting|40|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Mining|40|link=yes}}
*Any [[pickaxe]] and a [[brown apron]], [[golden apron]], or [[Crafting cape]]
|-
|11. Squeeze through the crevice in the [[Dwarven mine]]s.
|
*{{SCP|Agility|42|link=yes}}
|-
|12. Chop and burn some [[Willow logs]] in [[Taverley]].
''Note: Willow trees can be found to the south-east along the lake. [[Willow tree (Farming)|Player-grown willow trees]] do not count towards completing the task.''
|
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|30|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Firemaking|30|link=yes}}
*Any [[axe]] and a [[tinderbox]]
|-
|13. Craft a [[basket|fruit basket]] on the [[Falador Farm]] [[loom]].
|
*{{SCP|Crafting|36|link=yes}} (and {{SCP|Farming|30|link=yes}} for [[Ironman mode|Ironman accounts]])
*6 [[Willow branch]]es
|-
|14. Teleport to [[Falador]].
|
*{{SCP|Magic|37|link=yes}}
*Means to cast [[Falador Teleport]] ({{RuneReq|Air=3|Water=1|Law=1}})
|}
{{Notelist}}

===Rewards===
*[[Falador shield 2]]:
**Can restore 50% of [[prayer points]] once a day
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 experience in any skill of at least level 40
*10% more experience from the [[Falador farm|Falador farming patch]]
*Access to the [[Dark tunnel (Motherlode Mine)|dark tunnel shortcut]] in the [[Motherlode Mine]] (with 54 [[Agility]]) 
*Roughly 21% increased chance of receiving a [[clue scroll (medium)|medium clue scroll]] from a [[guard]] in [[Falador]] (from 1/128 to 1/106)

==Hard==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Falador" data-diary-tier="Hard"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Craft 140 [[Mind rune]]s simultaneously from Essence without the use of [[Extracts]].
''Note: [[Mind core|Mind cores]] do not count.''
|
*{{SCP|Runecraft|56|link=y}}
*{{SCP|Runecraft|42|link=y}} with 3+ [[Raiments of the Eye]] pieces
*28 [[Pure essence|pure]], [[Daeyalt essence|daeyalt]], or [[rune essence]] (less may suffice at higher [[Runecraft]] levels)
*Access to the [[Mind Altar]] ([[mind talisman]]/[[mind tiara|tiara]], [[catalytic talisman]]/[[Catalytic tiara|tiara]], or the [[Abyss]])
|-
|2. Change your [[heraldic crest|family crest]] to the [[Saradomin]] symbol.
''Note: This is done by talking to [[Sir Renitee]].''
|
*{{SCP|Prayer|70|link=yes}} {{Boostable|n}}
*{{SCP|Construction|16|link=yes}}{{Boostable|y}}
*5,000 [[coins]] (an additional 5,000 [[coins]] if your randomised [[heraldic crest|family crest]] already is [[Saradomin]], to change to another and back)
|-
|3. Kill the [[Giant Mole]] beneath [[Falador Park]].
|
*[[Spade]] and [[light source]]
*See the [[Giant Mole/Strategies|strategy guide]]
|-
|4. Kill a [[Skeletal Wyvern]] in the [[Asgarnia Ice Dungeon]].
|
*{{SCP|Slayer|72|link=yes}} {{Boostable|y}}
*Protection from the wyvern's [[icy breath]] and [[weapon]]ry to slay it
|-
|5. Complete a lap of the [[Falador Rooftop Course|Falador rooftop agility course]].
|
*{{SCP|Agility|50|link=yes}} {{Boostable|y}}
|-
|6. Enter the [[mining guild]] while wearing a [[Prospector helmet]].
''Note: This helmet can be obtained from the [[Motherlode Mine]] or the [[Volcanic Mine]].''
|
*{{SCP|Mining|60|link=yes}}
*[[Prospector helmet]] or [[golden prospector helmet]]
|-
|7. Kill the [[Blue Dragon]] under the [[Heroes' Guild]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of the [[Heroes' Quest]]
*Protection from [[dragonfire]] and [[weapon]]ry to slay it
|-
|8. Crack a [[Wall safe (lobby)|wall safe]] within [[Rogues' Den]].
''Note: [[Wall safe]]s in the maze do not count towards completing this task.''
|
*{{SCP|Thieving|50|link=yes}}
|-
|9. Recharge your [[prayer]] in the [[Rimmington church|Port Sarim church]] while wearing full [[Proselyte armour|Proselyte]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[The Slug Menace]]
*{{SCP|Defence|30|link=yes}}
*{{SCP|Prayer|20|link=yes}}
*Full [[Proselyte armour]]
|-
|10. Enter the [[Warriors' Guild]].
|
*130 combined levels in {{SCP|Attack|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Strength|link=yes}}, or level 99 in either
|-
|11. Equip a [[dwarven helmet]] within the [[dwarven mine]]s.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Grim Tales]]
*{{SCP|Defence|50|link=yes}}
*[[Dwarven helmet]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Falador shield 3]]:
**Can restore full [[prayer points]] once a day
**Indicates the [[Giant Mole]]'s location when equipped or held in the inventory in the [[Mole Hole]]
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 experience in any skill of at least level 50
*The [[Giant Mole]]'s [[mole skin]] and [[Mole claw|claw]] drops will be [[Bank note|noted]]
*Access to the [[bank]] chest and [[Bank Deposit Box|bank deposit box]] in the [[Crafting Guild]]
*Access to the [[Crevice (Heroes' Guild)|shortcut]] to the [[Fountain of Heroes]] in the [[Heroes' Guild]] basement (with 67 [[Agility]])

==Elite==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Falador" data-diary-tier="Elite"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Craft 252 [[Air Rune]]s simultaneously from Essence without the use of [[Runic extract|Extracts]].
|
*{{SCP|Runecraft|88|link=y}}
*{{SCP|Runecraft|77|link=y}} with 2 [[Raiments of the Eye]] pieces or 1 [[Raiments of the Eye]] piece and [[abyssal lantern]] (with willow or redwood logs)
*{{SCP|Runecraft|66|link=y}} with 3 [[Raiments of the Eye]] pieces
*{{SCP|Runecraft|55|link=y}} with 4 [[Raiments of the Eye]] pieces
*28 [[Pure essence|pure]], [[Daeyalt essence|daeyalt]], or [[rune essence]] (less may suffice at higher [[Runecraft]] levels)
*Access to the [[Air Altar]] ([[air talisman]]/[[air tiara|tiara]], [[elemental talisman]]/[[Elemental tiara|tiara]], or the [[Abyss]])
|-
|2. Purchase a [[white 2h sword|White 2h Sword]] from [[Sir Vyvin]].
''Note: Selling this sword to him and then buying it back without having the proper rank does not count for this achievement.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Wanted!]]
*1,920 [[coins]]
*Rank of [[White equipment#Knight rankings|White Knight Master]] (requires a [[Black Knight]] kill score of 1300 - this rank automatically starts at White Knight Novice, with a kill score of 100)
|-
|3. Find at least 3 [[magic roots]] at once when digging up your [[magic tree (Farming)|magic tree]] in [[Falador]].
''Note: You need to cut the tree down yourself.''
|
*{{SCP|Farming|91|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Woodcutting|75|link=yes}}
*[[Magic sapling]], [[spade]] and any [[axe]]
|-
|4. Perform a [[Cape of Accomplishment|skillcape]] or [[Quest point cape|quest cape]] emote at the top of [[White Knights' Castle|Falador Castle]].
|
*Completion of all [[quest]]s or [[Skill mastery|level 99]] in any skill
*Any [[Cape of Accomplishment]] (except for [[Cape of Accomplishment#Joke Skillcapes|joke skillcapes]] or the [[Max cape]])
|-
|5. Jump over the [[Strange floor (Taverley Dungeon)|strange floor]] in [[Taverley Dungeon|Taverley dungeon]].
''Note: Might take several tries. You must take no damage from the jump.''
|
*{{SCP|Agility|80|link=yes}}
|-
|6. Mix a [[Saradomin brew]] in [[Falador east bank]].
|
*{{SCP|Herblore|81|link=yes}}
*[[Toadflax potion (unf)]], [[crushed nest]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Falador shield 4]]:
**Can restore full [[prayer points]] twice a day
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*The [[tree patch]] in [[Falador Park]] will never get [[Disease (Farming)|diseased]]
*Access to the larger [[Amethyst crystals|amethyst]] mine in the west of the [[Mining Guild]]
*Slightly increased chance of receiving higher level [[Pay-dirt#Cleaning|ores]] when cleaning [[pay-dirt]], by about 1% per ore{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1239199151243644928|date=15 March 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101939|archivedate=15 March 2020|quote=There's just one buff to pay-dirt, and it's for the elite diary only. This matches what the diary master says if asked.|name=Falador Diary reward tweet}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1536370067935358978|date=13 June 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109709|archivedate=9 July 2022|quote=The roll for each ore type is increased by about 1 percentage point.}}
